subject: Problem with Correlation and Principal Components analyses?

messages.author: beda5f921330b64e
messages.subject: Problem with Correlation and Principal Components analyses?
parts: I have a problem with the the correlation and principal components analyses in the latest version of Rattle (2.6.18). After loading a data set, selecting one of these analyses and clicking on Execute, Rattle doesn't produce any output.  There are no error or warning messages on the R console.  I have reproduced the problem on two different computers, one running Windows XP and the other running Windows 7 Home Edition, and with different data sets on each computer.  Both machines have the latest version of R (2.15.0) and all R packages are up to date.

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: Problem with Correlation and Principal Components analyses?
parts:
Hi Mike,

Thanks for the bug report. I could reproduce it and have fixed the
problem. The fix will appear in 2.6.19. I will email you an update
separately. If anyone else needs this update before the release of
2.6.19 (perhaps 2 weeks away still) please let me know.

Regards,
Graham

Hi Graham

Related to this posting - I am teaching a course CIS8008 Business Intelligence where we are using Rattle as a data mining tool and practical component in this course

I noticed today that some students are experiencing problems with the use of Rattle in relation to correlation analysis of their assignment data set - which I believe is similar to what is outlined here because they are probably using Rattle version 2.6.18 - I personally are still using Rattle version 2.6.17 and have had no problems

Graham can you email me the Rattle 2.6.19 update via lane...@gmail.com

Regards Michael
